description: This file defines the FileDocumentStore class, a singleton service that manages storing and retrieving document objects as JSON files in the file system, within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It handles document lifecycle operations such as get, create, update, and serialization, with concurrency control via a semaphore.

classes.name: FileDocumentStore
classes.description: A service class that manages storing documents as JSON files in the tenant-specific directory, supporting get, create, update, and transaction commit operations.

methods.name: GetOrCreateMutableAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a mutable document instance from cache or storage, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: GetOrCreateImmutableAsync
methods.description: Retrieves an immutable document instance, indicating whether it was loaded from cache or storage.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Updates a document and executes a callback after a successful commit.

methods.name: AfterCommitSuccess
methods.description: Registers a callback to execute after a successful commit.

methods.name: AfterCommitFailure
methods.description: Registers a callback to execute after a failed commit.

methods.name: CommitAsync
methods.description: Not implemented; intended to commit changes.

methods.name: GetDocumentAsync
methods.description: Reads a document from the JSON file based on its type.

methods.name: SaveDocumentAsync
methods.description: Serializes and saves a document to the JSON file.
